job.description:
About the Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Coordinator to join a major Queensland Government program of work. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing UAT to ensure that delivered solutions meet agreed business requirements, acceptance criteria, and quality standards prior to production release. Acting as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, you will enable informed release decisions within a complex delivery environment.
This role aligns with industry best practice, focusing on business validation, risk-based testing, governance, and strong stakeholder engagement.

The Program
You will oversee UAT across three key projects within the program:

Camera Image and Data Management System (CIDMS): Replacing core systems that ingest, process, and validate camera data before sending it to the QLD Revenue Office for infringement processing.

Planning Services Project (PSP): Implementing a camera scheduling application and asset management system to support planning functions for mobile and transportable camera sites and locations.

Data Analytics and Reporting Platform (DARP): Establishing a new data lake and data warehouse with self-service capabilities and regular reporting outputs.

Key Responsibilities

  • UAT Planning and Preparation: Develop, maintain, and gain approval for UAT plans aligned to Agile and Hybrid project delivery models.
  • Scope and Criteria Definition: Define UAT scope, entry and exit criteria, acceptance criteria, and success measures in consultation with business stakeholders.
  • Test Case Development: Create UAT test cases derived from business workflows, requirements, user stories, and non-functional requirements.
  • Readiness Coordination: Coordinate readiness activities, including environment availability, system integrations, user access, and representative test data.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Program Test Manager, Project Test Leads, and Release Coordinator on all testing activities.
  • UAT Execution and Coordination: Coordinate and manage UAT execution across the program.

How to Apply
If you are a detail-oriented UAT Coordinator with strong stakeholder management skills and experience in complex government or enterprise environments, please submit your updated CV today.
